rulesText: Get the wolf and both sheep to the far bank.
The boat holds the farmer and one animal.
Never leave the wolf alone with exactly one sheep. Two sheep together are safe.
Tap an animal to put it in the boat (tap again to take it out).
Tap the boat or the Row button to cross.
lossText: The wolf was left alone with one sheep. Now the sheep has no wool, and the wolf has a fluffy beard!
winText: Perfect, that is the shortest solution!

rulesText: Get the wolf, the goat and the cabbage to the far bank.
The boat holds the farmer and one passenger.
Never leave the wolf alone with the goat, or the goat alone with the cabbage.
Tap a passenger to put it in the boat (tap again to take it out).
Tap the boat or the Row button to cross.
winText: Perfect, that is the shortest solution!

rulesText: Get exactly 4 litres of water into one jug.
You have a 3 L jug and a 5 L jug, with no marks in between.
Fill a jug at the pump, empty it into the river, or pour one into the other until it is full or empty.
Tap a jug to pick it up, then choose Fill, Pour or Empty.
Or, holding a jug, tap the pump, the river or the other jug.
winText: Perfect, that is the shortest solution!

rulesText: Move the whole jade tower from the left pillar to the golden sun pillar on the right.
Only the top disc of a pillar can move, one disc at a time.
Never put a bigger disc on top of a smaller one.
Tap a pillar to lift its top disc.
Tap another pillar to drop it there. Tap the same pillar to put it back.
hintText: Move the smallest disc from the left pillar to the middle pillar
winText: That is the shortest solution! Can you do it without a hint?

rulesText: Get all four explorers over the rope bridge to the temple.
At most two can be on the bridge at once, and they must carry the torch.
Pip takes 1 minute, Juno 2, Bram 5 and Grandpa Mo 10. A pair walks at the slower pace.
The torch burns out after 17 minutes.
Tap one or two explorers next to the torch to send them to the bridge.
Tap the Cross button (or the bridge) to walk over.
winText: Perfect, that is the shortest solution!

texts: Move the jade tower, one disc at a time.
Never let the guardians outnumber you.
A balloon for two and a lot of jealousy.
Split 8 litres of potion into two fours.

Riddlebrook is a puzzle game. This policy covers the Riddlebrook app for iPhone and iPad.
The short version: Riddlebrook collects nothing about you.
Nothing. The game does not collect, send or share any personal information or any information about your device or how you play.
The game has no accounts and never asks for your name, email address, age or location.
The game contains no advertising and no in-app purchases.
The game contains no analytics, tracking or advertising software from us or from anyone else.
Riddlebrook is a general-audience game. It collects no information from anyone, of any age.

You get the app from Apple's App Store. Apple may collect information about downloads and, if you have agreed to share it in your device's settings, about how apps are used and when they crash. If you back up your device, the backup may include the game's saved stars and settings, as it does for your other apps. All of that is governed by Apple's own privacy policy, not this one. We do not add anything to it.
If a future version of the game changes any of this, we will update this policy and its date before that version is released.
Questions about this policy: see the Contact page of this screen.
A question, a riddle that misbehaves, or an idea for the game? Write to us. It helps to say which iPhone or iPad you use and which riddle you were on.
The contact address will be here before the game is released.

texts: Five moon-flowers, eleven crystals and one very light sleeper.
A tighter knot of logs, and Dottie is no more patient than before.
Shelly has a new mosaic of the whole family, and it is in a worse muddle.
Three striped crickets, three spotted ones and twelve toadstools to cross.
The jade tower again, by night, and one disc taller.

rulesText: One of the 12 gold coins is a fake. It is either a little heavier or a little lighter than the rest.
You may use the great balance only 3 times.
Then name the fake coin and say if it is heavier or lighter.
The vault is cunning: a lucky guess never works. Only a plan that covers every case will open it.
Tap a coin to put it on the left pan, tap again for the right pan, once more to take it back.
Press Weigh when both pans hold the same number of coins.
Press Name the fake, tap a coin, then choose heavier or lighter.

texts: The balance is spent. Name the fake!

winText: Perfect, that is the shortest solution!

rulesText: Dottie the duck is stuck on her raft. Get the raft out through the gap in the right bank.
Logs only slide along their length, never sideways, and never through each other.
One slide counts as one move, however far it goes.
Dottie gets grumpy. After 50 slides she will try to hop home over the logs!
Drag a log along the water to slide it.
Or tap a log, then tap a glowing ring to send it there.
winText: Perfect, that is the shortest solution!

rulesText: A moonbeam shines across the lagoon. Crystal mirrors bounce it to the side.
Light all five moon-flowers with the beam at the same time to make them bloom.
Shh! Never let the beam touch the sleeping toad, or he will sneeze everything away. He sleeps right beside the way in, so mind the order of your turns.
Tap a crystal to turn it.
Watch where the beam goes before you tap the next one.
winText: Perfect, that is the shortest solution!

rulesText: Dottie the duck is stuck again, and this jam is tighter. Get her raft out through the gap in the right bank.
Logs only slide along their length, never sideways, and never through each other.
One slide counts as one move, however far it goes.
Dottie gets grumpy. After 75 slides she will try to hop home over the logs!
Drag a log along the water to slide it.
Or tap a log, then tap a glowing ring to send it there.
winText: Perfect, that is the shortest solution!

rulesText: Shelly the turtle has a new mosaic: herself and her two little ones at sunset. The fireflies have mixed this one up too.
Slide the stones until the picture matches the one on the standing stone.
A stone can only slide into the empty gap next to it.
Shelly is sleepy: finish within 80 slides or she nods off. Tiny numbers in the corners can help.
Tap a stone next to the gap to slide it in. Glowing stones can move.
When the picture is whole, the last ★ piece jumps in by itself.
winText: Perfect, that is the shortest solution!

rulesText: Make the crickets swap ends: the spotted blue crickets onto the spotted blue toadstools at the back, the striped amber crickets onto the striped amber ones at the front.
A cricket leaps in an L: two toadstools straight, then one to the side. It may fly over anything on the way.
It can only land on an empty toadstool. There are three crickets a side now, so they get in each other's way.
Tap a cricket to make it leap. If it has more than one place to land, they light up: tap one.
winText: Perfect, that is the shortest solution!

rulesText: The jade tower has grown a fifth disc. Move all of it from the left pillar to the golden sun pillar on the right.
Only the top disc of a pillar can move, one disc at a time.
Never put a bigger disc on top of a smaller one.
One more disc doubles the work: every move counts.
Tap a pillar to lift its top disc.
Tap another pillar to drop it there. Tap the same pillar to put it back.
winText: Perfect, that is the shortest solution!
